description: Cross-repository file synchronization tool that uses intelligent iterative merging to unify multiple file versions with interactive conflict resolution. Features include batch processing with custom search paths and exclusion patterns, parallel file hashing for performance, persistent command history, and comprehensive automation capabilities for multi-repository workflows. Supports advanced diff visualization, pattern-based file discovery, and discrete processing phases with real-time progress reporting.
